# GitHub Copilot Usage Guide

This repository uses GitHub Copilot as an AI assistant.

## Workflow

[ Design Docs ]
    ↓
[ Prompt (.github/prompts) ]
    ↓
[ Copilot Chat / Coding Agent ]
    ↓
[ Generated Code ]
    ↓
[ Copilot Review / Review Agent ]
    ↓
[ Human Review & Merge ]

## Notes
- Copilot does NOT work automatically
- Developers must explicitly reference prompts and documents
